name: hv15_vm_cal_x-xcap0030-COMMIT
purpose: ONE VM calendar master hfd_hgi_vm_calendar, structural fix of the routed native FAIL of hv15_vm_cal_u-compact2330-24eeb93bb (TT+142.63/FF+14.27/DRC0 but launch 222.0 ps/4 pins, capture 206.2 ps/16 cfg_data pins, boundary spread 92.8 ps). Measured per-group TT arrivals on the routed ODB (raw source): W input-capture rung 305 flops mean 288.9 (237.7-308.7), E output flops 187 mean 220.2 (215.9-223.5), S outputs 36 mean 234.8, body 426 mean 258.0; R 260.8. Capture fails sit on the latest W leaves (start_* 306, cfg_data hi 306-309) and launch fails on the earliest E leaves, i.e. the IO hold pads pay for a single root spanning two faces. Fix: the capture rung (cfg_*_q/start_*_q) gets its own related same-frequency phase-0 CTS root clk_cap at the W face (multiple_cts_roots, explicit domains, related_same_frequency crossings timed by ordinary STA); clk keeps SRAM, body, E/S outputs and the reset synchroniser. Zero normal-edge change (exact benches unchanged); new typed clock pin clk_cap requested from the die lead.
